1. Go to **Deals**.
2. Select **New deal**.
3. Enter a **Deal name** and enter **5000** in the **Value** field (use numbers only).
4. Optionally choose a **Company**, **Contact**, **Stage**, and **Expected close date**. New deals start in the **New** stage by default.
5. Select **Save deal**.

The currency used is set in **Settings** > **Client profile**.
